title: Television home security system
summary: Nurse Marie Van Brittan Brown and her husband invented a home security system using television surveillance, patented in 1969.
why: A forerunner of modern video doorbells and home CCTV.

unsung.contribution: Co-invented a closed-circuit television home security system.
unsung.recognition: Manufacturers showed no interest and media coverage ceased after 1969; wider recognition came only decades later.
